name: AdPresso – The Next-Generation Ads Manager
author: adpresso

sections.description:
We know monetizing your WordPress site can be challenging. That’s why we built AdPresso with one goal in mind: to make ad management hassle-free. Our team of seasoned experts has spent years solving the challenges you face as a publisher, so you get a smart, time-saving solution. AdPresso is the complete tool that just works—letting you focus on your content while your revenue grows.

AdPresso provides a clean, structured interface and intelligent workflows that save you time and effort. The true power lies under the hood: a lightweight, high-performance code ensures fast loading times and an optimal user experience. Our plugin offers unmatched compatibility, working perfectly with all ad networks, ad types, and a wide range of popular third-party plugins. All of this is supported by an expert team with over 16 years of hands-on experience, ensuring you get fast, reliable help with any challenge.

Learn more on wpadpresso.com!

Features

We packed AdPresso with powerful features that give you complete control over your ads and simplify website monetization. Below is a selection of the key features that make AdPresso the ideal ad management solution.

Compatibility

AdPresso is designed for maximum flexibility. Its compatibility with virtually every ad network and ad type allows you to choose the monetization strategy that works best for your website and easily insert any ad code exactly where you need it.

  • All ad types: e.g., banners, text links, display ads, HTML5 ads, affiliate ads, or header bidding
  • All ad networks: e.g., Amazon, Google AdSense, Ezoic, Booking.com, AWIN, Tradedoubler, Mediavine, Infolinks

Ad Management

Managing your ads becomes smooth with a well-conceived UI that helps you maintain a clear overview and centrally control even the largest ad setups. The plugin provides a range of features to simplify ad optimization and ensure your campaigns run smoothly.

  • Smart UI for intuitive workflows
  • Unlimited ad units for all your monetization needs
  • Ad rotation and sliders for dynamic ad content
  • Scheduling with start and expiration dates
  • Optional ad label (e.g., “Advertisements”) above each banner
  • Ads.txt with your custom content
  • Affiliate disclosures
  • A/B testing and split tests for ad optimization
  • Ad blocker counter and ad blocker shield
  • Privacy compliance
  • Advanced Ads auto-import

Auto Ad Injection

AdPresso lets you automatically inject ads into your website using a wide range of placements, with no coding or manual content editing required. You can manage these time-saving placements centrally, giving you a clear overview of your entire ad setup. While you always have the option to insert ads manually, our auto-injection is the key to perfectly positioning your ads while saving you valuable time.

  • Inject ads at the top or bottom of post content, in the sidebar, footer, or header
  • All ad networks: e.g., Amazon, Google AdSense, Ezoic, Booking.com, AWIN, Tradedoubler, Mediavine, Infolinks
  • Inject ads within content after any specific paragraph, headline, image, or other HTML element

Google AdSense

AdPresso supports Google AdSense ads with dedicated AdSense features.

  • Verify your website with Google AdSense
  • Easily integrate Google Auto Ads
  • Automatically add the required entry to your ads.txt file

Targeting
Target your ads with precision to control who sees what, when, and where. AdPresso allows you to deliver ads to specific user segments while simultaneously defining the exact content where they should appear.

  • Content: Individual posts, pages, categories, tags, author, and age
  • Audience: by device, user role, referrer URL, user capability, browser language, IP address

Tracking

Monitor impressions, clicks, and CTR directly inside WordPress. Analyze your ad performance statistics in the backend using versatile filtering options to track performance segmented by placement and group.

  • Track impressions, clicks, and CTR in your WordPress backend
  • Analyze performance segmented by specific placements and groups
  • Active View Tracking ((Pro)
  • Google Analytics integration (Pro)

Privacy

AdPresso supports multiple consent methods to ensure your ads are delivered in full compliance with privacy regulations, and integrates with popular consent plugins.

  • Consent method auto-detection
  • Cookie consent
  • TCF consent

AdPresso Pro

The free AdPresso plugin is a complete toolkit for monetizing any website. But AdPresso Pro is the next step: a package of proven features designed to help you fine-tune your ad performance.

Click here to purchase the best premium WordPress ad management plugin now!

  • Advanced placements and layouts (e.g., ad grids, ad refresh, background ads, floating ads, page peel banners)
  • Precision targeting (e.g., keyword targeting, browser width)
  • Optimization tools (e.g., fallback ads, lazy loading, ad blocker features, link masking)
  • Advanced tracking (active view tracking & Google Analytics)
  • Advanced scheduling options (e.g., days of the week/hours)
sections.faq:
Is AdPresso an affiliate marketing plugin?

AdPresso supports all forms of website monetization and is a perfect solution for affiliate websites. For affiliate publishers, AdPresso includes a range of features for ad optimization. You get dedicated text link support and link masking, along with built-in tracking to monitor performance. The plugin offers automatic, targeted injection to place ads precisely in content (for instance, based on keywords). AdPresso provides full support for all affiliate networks, such as Amazon Associates, Awin, Tradedoubler, or CJ, while also ensuring smooth compatibility with other popular affiliate plugins, including Pretty Links, Thirsty Affiliates, AAWP, or Lasso.

Why should I choose AdPresso and not another ad management plugin?

We’ve spent years in the ad industry as both plugin developers and publishers, so we’ve seen it all. We built AdPresso because, as long-time users of plugins like Advanced Ads, Ad Inserter, WP QUADS, Ad Rotate, or AdSanity, we knew it was time for a new solution. AdPresso offers a more refined UI and streamlined workflows, designed to simplify your daily work and save you valuable time. We created the intelligent, efficient solution that we always wanted for ourselves.

Can I use AdPresso with any WordPress theme?

Yes, we designed AdPresso to be compatible with any WordPress theme or page builder like Divi, Oxygen, or Elementor. Our clean, lightweight code doesn’t interfere with your theme’s files, ensuring it works perfectly whether you’re using a classic, modern, or custom-built theme. For any specific placements, you always have the option to use manual insertion with shortcodes or PHP functions.

How do I get support?

If you have questions or need assistance with the free AdPresso plugin, we’re here to help. Your first stops should be our comprehensive documentation or the official support forum on wordpress.org, where we actively monitor and try to assist as quickly as possible.

If you have an active AdPresso Pro license, you get a full year of premium support in addition to all updates. For dedicated and priority assistance, please reach out directly to our customer support team through your specific contact channel. Feel free to also use this channel for any pre-sale questions you may have.
